title: Department of Veterans Affairs: Phase 56N Verified Remediation Decision
publisher: Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Inspector General
summary: The live VA OIG page shows recommendations 3, 4, and 8 Closed-Implemented on June 25, 2026 and recommendations 1, 2, 5, 6, and 7 Open. The follow-up found deficiencies across configuration management, security management, and access controls. Phase 56N decision: Publish the three-closed, five-open component result while keeping it separate from VA-wide FISMA and iFAMS remediation.
key_findings: Status period: Follow-up inspection issued June 25, 2026.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when VA OIG changes one of recommendations 1, 2, 5, 6, or 7 or publishes another compatible Southern Oregon follow-up.
why_it_matters: The record adds exact implementation, non-closure, component, or portfolio evidence while keeping recommendation states and operational outcomes distinct.
ftfn_relevance: Separates recommendation implementation from performance, service, mission, safety, and readiness outcomes.
Keeps source owner, record identity, status period, limitation, and continuation rule attached.
evidence_limits: One healthcare-system inspection cannot be generalized to VA enterprise controls, other facilities, clinical outcomes, or closure of separate iFAMS recommendations.
Closure evidence for the five open Southern Oregon actions, the separate iFAMS recommendations, the FY 2025 FISMA result, and measured service or incident outcomes.
No entity ranking, composite, productivity, readiness, value, or causal claim is supported.
